title: Mapterhorn
description: Mapterhorn is a global collection of terrain tiles in PMTiles format covering the full Web Mercator projection extent. Elevation data is encoded in Terrarium format, enabling hillshading and 3D terrain rendering in interactive web maps. Source elevation data is compiled from multiple open-data providers.
